name: Eliezer
overview: Eliezer was a male chief officer for the Reubenites, a tribe of Israel. He is identified specifically as the son of Zichri, highlighting his tribal lineage and leadership role within the Reubenite community. Scripture notes his position in the context of David's military organization.
namesAndTitles: The name Eliezer means 'G-d is my help,' reflecting a reliance on divine assistance. This proper name is recorded in 1 Chronicles 27:16 and carries no indication of being given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Eliezer is explicitly recorded as the son of Zichri. There are no other family relationships mentioned beyond this paternal connection in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Eliezer's significance lies in his leadership as the chief officer of the Reubenites during King David's reign. His role demonstrates the organized military structure of Israel under David and the trust placed in him as a commander. Being the son of Zichri situates him within a known family line, affirming his tribal identity and responsibility.
